mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS WHERE SVS.STAFF_ID = #{staffId}
mapper.select: SELECT SS. ID, SS. NAME, SS.PHONE, SV.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION, SV.VEHICLE_COLOR, SV.VEHICLE_TYPE, SV.VEHICLE_BRAND FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SVS.STAFF_ID = SS."ID" INNER JOIN SMT_VEHICLE SV ON SVS.VEHICLE_ID = SV. ID AND SV.ID = #{cardNo} AND SV.IS_DELETE = 0
SELECT SVS.VEHICLE_ID FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS WHERE SVS.STAFF_ID = #{staffId}

SELECT va.ID,ve.VEHICLE_PLATE,ve.ID as VID,vs.STAFF_ID,staff.JCHE_ID FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF vs JOIN SMT_VEHICLE ve ON vs.VEHICLE_ID = ve.ID JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY va ON va.VEHICLE_ID = ve.ID JOIN SMT_STAFF staff on vs.STAFF_ID=staff.ID WHERE va.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authId} and ve.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION=1 and va.STATUS=1
